additional_info.subject: RE: ID0408763-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R4 170001712] Missing Converter in DC2 CRM:01811000687
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
As pe reported issue, kindly find below attached steps and knowledge article.
Troubleshooting Steps:
Check for any loose connections to all the power converters.
Use a multimeter to verify the input to the power converter is within the permissible range.
Identify the missing converter by their serial numbers and verify if they are powered on.
If a converter is missing or not powering on, swap it with a known working one and check if the replaced converter powers on.
Examine the power converter display for any errors or if it shows any light.
If all the above steps have been performed and the power converter still does not power on, please proceed with replacing it.Kindly follow the KA if needed.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Power Converter_Missing converters - Dynamics 365
MLFB No.
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2 -TB1, -TB2, ... -TB15 Power Converter AC/DC 20kW
